description: This file defines the AttendanceDatabaseSource class, providing SQL access methods for attendance-related data stored in a local database. It includes methods for inserting data and querying attendance records by specific date or week range, utilizing an underlying LocalDb singleton.

classes.name: AttendanceDatabaseSource
classes.description: A singleton class providing SQL access methods for attendance data, including insertion and retrieval by date or week.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a row into the attendance table with the provided data.

methods.name: byDate
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records for a specific date.

methods.name: byWeekStart
methods.description: Retrieves all attendance records within a week starting from the given date.
